ability.claudeadv.name: Claude's Adventure
claudeadv.title: Claude's Adventure
claudeadv.hint: ←→ move · Space jump (again mid-air to double jump) · X fire {} · ↓ drop through · Esc pause
claudeadv.menu.keys: ↑↓ choose · Enter confirm · or just click
claudeadv.help.body:
←/→ or A/D: move
Space / W / ↑ / Z: jump, press again mid-air to double jump; hold for higher
↓ / S: drop through one-way platforms
X / J / K: fire a {} tool call, costs 1 Token each
Esc / P: pause

Stomp a Bug's head to fix it; saws are infinite loops — dodge them
Hallucination ghosts freeze while you face them, and creep closer when you turn away
The top bar is your context window — overflow kills you; summary scrolls clear 35%
? blocks give Tokens, git flags are checkpoints, the ✓ terminal is the goal

claudeadv.level.meadow.sub: "Can you fix this bug for me?" — and so it begins
claudeadv.level.jungle.name: Codebase Jungle
claudeadv.level.jungle.sub: 100k lines of uncommented code, tangled like vines
claudeadv.level.hell.name: Dependency Hell
claudeadv.level.hell.sub: Peer dependency conflicts churn in the lava
claudeadv.level.cloud.name: The Cloud
claudeadv.level.cloud.sub: The deploy pipeline floats above the clouds — one misstep is a 503
claudeadv.level.prod.name: Production
claudeadv.level.prod.sub: Friday, 5 PM. The legacy code awakens

The user replies: "Thanks! Could you add one small feature?"
